title: La fritanga
goal: Order from a fritanga like somebody who eats there
culture: The fritanga is the evening grill on the pavement, and it is where most people actually eat. An enchilado here is a fried stuffed tortilla off that grill and has nothing to do with the Mexican dish that shares the name.

beats.good: A fried, stuffed tortilla straight off the grill. Order it by name and nobody will ask you anything else about it.
The ensalada is shredded cabbage in vinegar and it goes on the plate, not beside it. Maduro is fried sweet plantain and you want that too.

beats.es: ¿Se lo sirvo aquí o se lo empaco?
beats.good: Para llevar gets it in a bag with the salad in a bag of its own. Aquí gets you a plastic chair on the pavement, which is the better answer.

beats.es: Se lo hago fresquito. Espéreme un poquito, pues.
beats.good: Ya va is the most useful two words in the country: coming right up, hang on, alright, I heard you. The tone does all the work.
